Alice — thanks for the roster and the clear ask. Quick answers up front, then proposed next steps: 

Short answers:
- Partner Center primarily uses the Microsoft Seller ID + account tenancy mapping (and can fall back to primary seller email). The most robust approach is to provide both MPN/Seller ID and the seller email in the referral payload.
- Preferred format: CSV or Excel with columns: account_tenant, account_alias, primary_seller_email, seller_id, priority_segment, brief opportunity summary. 
- Reduce rejection risk: include the most recent owner update timestamp (to show freshness), include an explicit note if the account has an existing opportunity number, and mark any accounts with shared ownership.

Proposed next steps (to get to EOD Fri):
1) Vanessa and Karthik and I (Redwood) will reconcile the Contoso roster against the seller roster we have from Azure Partner Center.
2) We’ll produce a "field coverage map" with a recommended primary seller per account and a fallback seller.
3) Contoso will upload the final CSV to Partner Center (or we can submit on your behalf if you prefer).

I attached a short seller-touch plan template (mop-seller-touchplan-v0.3.docx) and I can drop the reconciled mapping in Drive. Can Vanessa and Karthik confirm availability for a 30-minute sync at 1:30pm PT today? If not, we’ll do asynchronous recon and share the mapping by EOD.

-Jasmine
